# Copilot Instructions

## Project Directives
- NuGet package download failing with timeout and 'api.nuget.org' resolution issues. If automatic downloads fail, install the necessary NuGet/runtime components manually, as there are no proxy issues.
- For this project, no test, prototype, or experimental code should be added: all implementations must be professional, secure, and intended for production.
- Modifications to .github/copilot-instructions.md should not be automatically excluded; they may be included when necessary for the requested work.
